board.name: Isaac Orolugbagbe
board.title: Chairman
bio: Isaac Orolugbagbe is a Senior Fellow at the Strategy, Entrepreneurship and SPEB Department of Lagos Business School and an Adjunct Faculty, Strategy & Corporate Governance at Strathmore Business School, Nairobi, Kenya.

His areas of interest include business strategy, innovation and corporate governance. As CEO of Accelstra Limited (a Strategy and Innovation Consulting Company) he advises companies such as Merck KGaA, Inland Containers Nigeria Limited, SIFAX Group, Greensprings Schools and Courier Plus Services Limited on how to ensure profitable and sustainable growth using innovative principles and techniques and promotion of healthy culture to enable successful execution of business strategies.

For more than 30 years, Isaac has worked successfully at senior levels in diverse industries. These include Audit and Finance, Consulting, Aviation, Air Express Logistics, Freight and Maritime, Oil and Gas with a keen interest in Entrepreneurship. His indelible footprints can be seen in his roles as Treasury Controller DHL Nigeria, Senior Accountant Shell Petroleum Development Company, Managing Director, Red Star Express Plc., licensee of FedEx Corporation in West Africa (a position he held for 10 years), and CEO Skyway Aviation Handling Company (SAHCO Plc).

Currently Isaac is Chairman of Boctrust Microfinance Bank Limited, Chairman Fastizers Foods and Confectionery Limited, and Board Director for Beta Computers Limited, Park City Homes Limited and IDC Farms Limited. In the past, he served as Director for Thomas Wyatts Plc. and Vice-Chairman of Red Star Express Plc.

Isaac holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Ife (now OAU) and a Master of Business Leadership from the University of South Africa. He is a chartered accountant and a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants (FCA). He is also a Fellow of the Institute of Directors and Fellow of the Society for Corporate Governance Nigeria

board.name: Femi Alonge
board.title: Director
bio: Mr Alonge, a chartered banker, is the current Director and oversees the day-to-day management of the bank. with over 20 years local and international banking experience spanning Retail, Commercial and Corporate Banking.

He has worked with Guaranty Trust Bank, Lead Bank and Standard Chartered Bank where he spent over 16 years and held various positions such as Senior Credit Analyst, Area Manager. Head, Asset Backed Financing West Africa, Executive Director Corporate and Institutional Banking Tanzania as an International staff. In 2017, he was appointed CEO Africa Northstar Finance Services Mauritius.

He is an Engineering graduate from Obafemi Awolowo University and an MBA graduate from the University of Bangor U.K. He is a member of Chartered institute of Bankers Nigeria and an affiliate member of international compliance association London UK.

board.name: Abiola Olowude
board.title: Director
bio: Abiola Olowude is a seasoned Wealth and Fund Management Consultant whose career journey exemplifies versatility and excellence.
Her professional path began in the field of education, where she dedicated a decade to teaching at both secondary and tertiary levels.

She then transitioned seamlessly into the banking sector, where she honed her skills across various domains, including Banking Operations, Retail and Commercial Banking, and Funds & Relationship Management, over the course of two decades.

During her tenure in banking, Abiola rose to the Senior Management echelon within a leading commercial bank before embarking on a new chapter at Radix Capital, an esteemed independent Investment Banking institution.
At Radix Capital, she distinguished herself by overseeing the Private Funds and Wealth Management Unit, demonstrating her adeptness in financial strategy and client engagement.
Mrs. Olowude currently consults for private clients on growing and managing wealth and real estate.

board.name: Kunle Alonge
board.title: Director
bio: Has over 27years(with twelve at senior executive management levels) experience in banking (Corporate and Retail), Corporate Finance, SME, etc, in Nigeria and Africa. Previously served as Managing Director/Regional Head of Commercial Clients for Africa at Standard Chartered Bank Africa - covering countries in West, East and Southern Africa. Prior to that, served as Deputy CEO at FCMB, and Regional Director Client Relationships at Standard Chartered Bank East Africa - covering Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania.

He also served at various middle and senior level positions in Standard Chartered Bank Nigeria, Zenith Bank and erstwhile Chartered Bank Nigeria Limited Segun was a University of Lagos Scholar, graduating with both Bachelors and Masters of Science degrees in Banking and Finance from the University. He has attended various leadership and specialized courses in top notch universities such as HARVARD BUSINESS SCHOOL, OXFORD UNIVERSITY (SAID BUSINESS SCHOOL) AND LONDON BUSINESS SCHOOL.

board.name: Nkolika Okoli
board.title: Director
bio: With experience in the Financial services sector spanning over 25 years, Nkoli has had a distinguished career in Banking with expertise in Retail (Consumer and SME) and Commercial banking, Credit, Operations and Strategy. With an MBA (Distinction) from the University of Durham Business School, United Kingdom; Nkoli’s wide career experience encompasses 15 years in Executive Management, 18 years in relationship management across various customer segments as well as customer services, product development/management and corporate governance.

She has served on the board of Stanbicibtc Insurance Brokers as a Non-Executive Director and as the Country Head (Nigeria), Personal Banking Business, Stanbicibtc Bank where she was responsible for the Profit and Loss as well as driving strategic decisions of the banks Personal Banking Business.

Prior to this, she was the Group Head, Retail (Personal & SME) bank, for a leading Tier 2 bank where she collaborated with IFC specialists to develop a 5 year strategy to drive the banks Retail business.
Nkolika is passionate about social impact and loves supporting orphanages and other groups focused on children’s education and medical aid to the underprivileged.

board.name: Olumide Odunmbaku
board.title: Managing Director
bio: Mr. Olamide A. Odunmbaku officially joined BOCTRUST MFB March 2024, as the MD/CEO.

He is an astute professional with over 17 years’ core experience in Credit Analysis and management, Credit Restructuring, financial analysis and interpretation, facility structuring, people management, Management of Key risk indicators of the organization, Risk register, compliance to major regulatory provisions et al.

In the course of his professional journey, Mr. Odunmbaku has worked in the following organizations: Integrated Microfinance Bank Limited, Fina Trust Microfinance Bank Limited, Personal Trust Microfinance Bank Limited, Purplemoney Microfinance Bank Limited, IBILE Microfinance Bank Limited and Moneyfield Microfinance Bank Limited.

Mr. Odunmbaku is a graduate of Biochemistry from Yaba College of Technology - YABATECH Lagos and holds a Post Graduate Diploma (PGD) in Accounting and a Master of Business Administration (Finance) from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology, Ogbomosho Oyo State. He also holds a Certified Professional Diploma (CPD) in Credit Management from Postgraduate School of Credit and Financial Management. Olamide is an Associate Member of Institute of Chartered Accountant of Nigeria (ICAN), an Affiliate Member of Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP), a Member of Chartered Institute of Loan and Risk Management of Nigeria (CILRMN) and a Certified Microfinance Professional (MCP).
He recently (May 2023) bagged an Executive MBA from Quantic School of Business and Technology, Washington DC, USA

management.name: Odunmbaku Akinlawon Olamide
management.title: MD/CEO
management.qualifications: HND, PGD, CPD, MBA, EMBA, MCIB, ACA
bio: Mr. Olamide A. Odunmbaku officially joined BOCTRUST MFB in March 2024 as the MD/CEO.

He is an astute professional with over 17 years’ core experience in Credit Analysis and management, Credit Restructuring, financial analysis and interpretation, facility structuring, people management, Management of Key risk indicators of the organization, Risk register, and compliance to major regulatory provisions.

In the course of his professional journey, Mr. Odunmbaku has worked in the following organizations: Integrated Microfinance Bank Limited, Fina Trust Microfinance Bank Limited, Personal Trust Microfinance Bank Limited, Purplemoney Microfinance Bank Limited, IBILE Microfinance Bank Limited and Moneyfield Microfinance Bank Limited.

Mr. Odunmbaku is a graduate of Biochemistry from Yaba College of Technology (YABATECH), Lagos and holds a Post Graduate Diploma (PGD) in Accounting and a Master of Business Administration (Finance) from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology, Ogbomosho, Oyo State. He also holds a Certified Professional Diploma (CPD) in Credit Management from the Postgraduate School of Credit and Financial Management. He recently bagged an Executive MBA from Quantic School of Business and Technology, Washington DC, USA.

Olamide is an Associate Member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ICAN), an Affiliate Member of the Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP), a Member of the Chartered Institute of Loan and Risk Management of Nigeria (CILRMN) and a Certified Microfinance Professional (MCP).

management.name: Femi Olatunde
management.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
bio: Dr. Femi Olatunde is the Chief Operating Officer of BOCTRUST Microfinance Bank, with over 15 years’ banking experience spanning credit risk, business development, and human capital management.
He previously worked at Oceanic Bank, Ecobank, and Mutual Benefits Microfinance Bank, where he served as Acting Managing Director.

He holds degrees from the University of Calabar and the University of Lagos, and a Ph.D in Economics from Obafemi Awolowo University. He is an Associate of the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (ACIB).

management.name: Adedayo Azeez
management.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
bio: Adedayo Azeez is the Chief Financial Officer of BOCTRUST Microfinance Bank, with over 10 years’ experience in accounting, external audit, and internal controls.
His career path includes Fortis Microfinance Bank, Empire Trust Microfinance Bank, and Nile Capital.

He graduated from Olabisi Onabanjo University with a degree in Accounting. He is an Associate Member of the Institute of Strategic Management of Nigeria (ISMN) and a member of the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (CIBN).

management.name: Olamide Emmanuel Fanijoko
management.title: Head, Credit & Recovery
bio: Olamide Emmanuel Fanijoko is an experienced banking professional with over 13 years of progressive experience in credit risk management, loan recovery, portfolio administration, and banking operations. He currently serves as Head of Credit & Recovery, where he is responsible for credit appraisal, portfolio quality management, recovery of delinquent facilities, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance.

Mr. Fanijoko has demonstrated exceptional competence in managing loan portfolios, implementing effective recovery strategies, maintaining portfolio quality within regulatory thresholds, and supporting sustainable business growth. His expertise spans credit analysis, debt recovery, loan restructuring, customer relationship management, credit bureau reporting, and legal recovery processes.

Prior to joining Boctrust Microfinance Bank, he built a solid foundation in banking operations during his tenure at First Bank of Nigeria Limited, where he gained extensive experience in credit administration, account management, funds transfer operations, clearing services, customer service, and cash management.

He holds a Higher National Diploma (HND) in Business Administration from Yaba College of Technology, Lagos, and is a Member of the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (MCIB). He is committed to continuous professional development and the application of sound credit risk management practices that enhance organizational performance and stakeholder value.
Mr. Fanijoko is recognized for his strong analytical skills, integrity, professionalism, leadership capabilities, and results-driven approach to banking and financial services.

management.name: Olalekan Ogunsola
management.title: Head, Risk, Control & Compliance
bio: Olalekan is a highly motivated, results-oriented, and experienced banking professional with over a decade of progressive experience in the Nigerian microfinance industry. He holds a Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Accounting, a Certified Microfinance Practitioner (MCIB), and is currently pursuing the Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA) qualification.

He possesses extensive experience in Risk Management, Internal Audit, Regulatory Compliance, Credit Administration, Financial Analysis, and Internal Controls, with a proven track record of strengthening governance frameworks, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Throughout his career, he has successfully led initiatives that improved risk management practices, reinforced internal control systems, and supported sound corporate governance across various microfinance institutions.

Recognized for his integrity, analytical mindset, and leadership abilities, Olalekan is passionate about building high-performing teams, promoting a strong risk culture, and delivering sustainable value through effective governance, audit, and compliance practices.

management.name: Omolabake Oladapo
management.title: Head, Human Resources
bio: Omolabake is the Head of Human Resources at Boctrust Microfinance Bank, bringing over eight years of combined expertise in human resources and customer relations. Known for her ability to build strong relationships and navigate diverse work environments, she uniquely leverages her background in accounting to drive strategic, data-informed HR initiatives.

Omolabake joined Boctrust in 2018 as a Customer Service Officer, where her talent and dedication led to her deployment to the HR department the following year, a team she now leads. She holds a degree in Accounting from Obafemi Awolowo University, is a member of the Human Resource Certification Institute (HRCI) as a Professional in Human Resources International, and is a certified Microfinance Practitioner (MCP).

management.name: Nsisong James
management.title: Sales/Treasury Manager
bio: Nsisong James is a results -driven sales and Treasury Manager with 6+ years’ experience managing liquidity, funding, investments, and market risk in a regulated microfinance bank.

She has a proven track record of strengthening deposit mobilization, optimising cost of funds, and ensuring compliance with CBN/MFB recapitalization and liquidity requirements. She is skilled at balancing asset-liability management with the realities of serving market traders, SMEs, individuals and informal sector clients.

Her roles include Liquidity & ALM functions with daily cash flow forecasting, maturity gap analysis, and liquidity stress testing. She is also responsible for the Funding Strategy of the bank by mobilizing low cost savings funds and interbank placement and oversees the investment Management scheme by Placement of funds in CBN T-Bills, commercial papers, and other low-risk instruments within MFB guidelines.

Nsisong has overtime developed a strong penchant for identifying opportunities to improve the liquidity position of the bank at every periodic stage by consistently following up on potential leads and high value clients…

management.name: Stephen Olanrewaju Lambo
management.title: Chief Technology Officer
bio: Stephen Olanrewaju Lambo is a seasoned banking executive and technology professional with over 16 years of experience in digital transformation, business development, information technology, electronic banking, and financial services management. He has built a strong reputation for leading strategic initiatives that drive business growth, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer experience through innovation and technology.

Throughout his career, Olanrewaju has held senior leadership roles including Area Manager at Modern Lottery Nigeria, Head of Business Development & Information Technology at Reliance Microfinance Bank, and Head of Business Development & Information Technology at Mayfair Microfinance Bank. In these positions, he led digital transformation projects, managed enterprise IT infrastructure, implemented electronic banking solutions, and supported sustainable revenue growth across business operations.

He has extensive experience in core banking platforms, payment systems, information security, project management, business process improvement, and technology governance, with a proven track record in deploying digital channels such as ATM, POS, USSD, mobile banking, instant card issuance, and agency banking solutions. Stephen holds a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Statistics from the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, and an Ordinary National Diploma in Chemical Engineering from Lagos State Polytechnic, along with certifications in Microsoft SQL Server, Digital Banking, and Web Development.

management.name: Bukola Sofola
management.title: Operations Manager
bio: Bukola Sofola is a seasoned operations executive with over a decade of experience in the banking sector. A Certified Microfinance Practitioner (MCP) of the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria, she is also a fellow member and Chartered Customer Service Professional (FCICRM) of the Chartered Institute of Customer Relationship Management.

Specializing in customer experience management and operational excellence, Bukola has a proven track record of leading high-performing teams, driving service delivery improvements, and overseeing critical operational functions. Her expertise spans process optimization, internal controls, compliance adherence and technology integration to enable efficient and secure banking operations.

Her background includes roles in customer service management, as well as being a head Teller, Funds Transfer Officer, and Administrative Executive. She consistently identifies opportunities for process optimisation and innovation to ensure seamless customer interactions at every touchpoint.

management.name: Samuel Oseni
management.title: Group Head of Sales
bio: Highly accomplished and results-driven Banking and Financial Services Professional with over 10 years of progressive experience in sales management, business development, consumer and commercial lending, portfolio management, relationship management, and credit administration. Possesses a Bachelor's Degree in Economics from the University of Uyo, Akwa Ibom State.

Currently serving as a Regional Sales Manager at Boctrust Microfinance Bank, leading high-performing sales teams, drive revenue growth, expand market penetration, and deliver sustainable business results. Demonstrated expertise in developing and executing strategic sales initiatives, customer acquisition strategies, loan portfolio growth, credit assessment, and risk-conscious lending practices.

A strong leader with proven ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Risk Management, Operations, and Business Support functions to achieve organizational objectives and enhance overall business performance. Adept at identifying market opportunities, building strategic relationships, and implementing innovative solutions that drive profitability and operational efficiency.

Possesses sound knowledge of financial analysis, business management, strategic planning, product development, and credit evaluation. Highly skilled in sourcing, appraising, structuring, and managing quality consumer and business loan portfolios while ensuring compliance with regulatory and organizational standards.

Recognized for exceptional leadership, integrity, professionalism, and a strong commitment to excellence. Consistently delivers measurable results through effective team management, customer-focused service delivery, and strategic business development initiatives that contribute significantly to organizational growth and long-term success.

management.name: Olaniyi Osunlana
management.title: Group Head of Sales
bio: A seasoned banking professional with over 15 years of experience in sales, business development, consumer and business lending, and relationship management within the financial services industry. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Sociology and Anthropology from Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife.

Currently serving as a Group Sales Manager at Boctrust Microfinance Bank, with extensive experience in sales planning and execution, customer acquisition, portfolio management, and credit administration. Proven ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Risk Management, Operations, and Support teams to drive business growth, increase revenue, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Possesses strong expertise in business management, financial analysis, strategic planning, and product development. Skilled in the acquisition, appraisal, creation, and evaluation of quality consumer and business loans, as well as coordinating product development initiatives and staff training programmes.

A results-oriented leader recognized for professionalism, integrity, and excellence, with a consistent track record of contributing to organizational growth and delivering outstanding business performance.

management.name: Charles Egbochie
management.title: Head, Digital Banking
bio: Charles Egbochie is a seasoned bank operations, fintech and digital banking leader with a proven track record of combining traditional standards with new technology. Currently serving as the Head of Digital Banking at Boctrust Microfinance Bank, he specializes in designing, deploying, and optimizing robust digital financial ecosystems that drive financial inclusion and operational efficiency.

With over six years of foundational operational excellence—including his previous tenure as Head of Operations and Digital Banking at Rephidim Microfinance Bank—Charles possesses deep expertise in scaling digital infrastructure. His competencies span the full spectrum of electronic channels and digital products, including POS deployments, ATM management, debit cards management, USSD solutions, and dedicated mobile & web banking applications.

An academically accomplished professional, Charles holds a BSc (Second-Class Upper) in Economics, is a Microfinance Certified Professional (MCP) with the UK Microfinance Association, and is currently pursuing an MSc to further elevate his strategic capacity. Committed to securing the future of digital finance, he is also completing a specialized cybersecurity certification through TS Academy, UK.

As a trained Data Scientist and tech enthusiast, he integrates technical command of SQL, python, machine learning, and computer vision to improve banking operations. He combines data insights, security, and product management to keep banking systems secure while growing digital services.
